name: MLE-Bench
intro: MLE-Bench是一个用于评估AI智能体在机器学习工程方面表现的基准。它收集了75个Kaggle机器学习工程竞赛，旨在测试AI智能体在模型训练、数据准备和实验运行等方面的真实世界技能。该基准通过开源智能体脚手架评估了前沿语言模型，并建立了人类基线。
org: OpenAI, University of California Berkeley, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Stanford Universit
build_method: 75个来自Kaggle的机器学习工程相关竞赛
task_type: Agent任务, 机器学习工程
intro_en: MLE-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' performance in machine learning engineering. It compiles 75 Kaggle machine learning engineering competitions to test agents' real-world skills in model training, data preparation, and experiment execution. The benchmark assesses state-of-the-art language models using an open-source agent framework and establishes a human baseline.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect machine-learning engineering competitions from Kaggle as real-world tasks"] --> B["Curate 75 competitions spanning modalities and ML problem types"]
    B --> C["Use preparation scripts to split public training data into offline train/test sets"]
    C --> D["Package each competition with descriptions, sample submissions, and local grading scripts"]
    D --> E["Run language-model agents through open-source scaffolds to train models and submit CSV predictions"]
    E --> F["Apply rule-violation and plagiarism checks before accepting submissions"]
    F --> G["Compare scores with Kaggle public leaderboard human baselines"]
    G --> H["Report medal rate and competition-level performance for ML engineering capability"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从Kaggle收集机器学习工程竞赛作为真实任务来源"] --> B["筛选75个覆盖多模态和多类机器学习问题的竞赛"]
    B --> C["用准备脚本把公开训练集重新切分为离线训练和测试集"]
    C --> D["为每个竞赛打包描述、样例提交和本地评分脚本"]
    D --> E["让语言模型Agent通过开源脚手架训练模型并提交CSV预测"]
    E --> F["在接受提交前执行规则违规和抄袭检查"]
    F --> G["将得分与Kaggle公开排行榜中的人类基线比较"]
    G --> H["用奖牌率和分竞赛表现报告机器学习工程能力"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.07095 and the OpenAI MLE-Bench repository. The benchmark curates 75 Kaggle ML engineering competitions, reconstructs held-out evaluation by splitting public training data, supplies grading scripts for CSV submissions, runs AI agents with open-source scaffolds, uses rule-violation/plagiarism checks, compares against Kaggle public leaderboards, and reports medal-rate style outcomes.
